MUST: pin the union's dedup — in P6a assert from-A appears EXACTLY once (A's tic is in its worktree AND on origin after its push); a non-deduping union passes all five today. SHOULD: (1) P6c's snapshot runs 'git status', which can refresh/rewrite the index (racy-git) — run it with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 / --no-optional-locks so the observer can't perturb what it measures; (2) state stamp semantics in the ADR/brief: the stamp = last SUCCESSFUL fetch into refs/remotes/origin/<branch> (by read or emit); a failed or branchless fetch never sets it — else P6d's first read wouldn't fetch. NICE: one 'bus as of' assertion on board (the contract named log+board); note a network timeout for hung remotes (renamed-dir offline fails fast, a dead host doesn't).
